providers.label: Azure OpenAI
providers.note: Set AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT (e.g. https://my-resource.openai.azure.com) in your .env.

providers.label: Stripe
providers.note: Stripe SDK v14+ needs host override: new Stripe(key, { host: 'init.vaultproof.dev' })

providers.label: Chargebee
providers.note: Set CHARGEBEE_SITE_URL (e.g. https://example.chargebee.com) in your .env.

providers.label: Adyen
providers.note: Set ADYEN_API_URL to your Adyen checkout, terminal, or platform API endpoint.

providers.label: Twilio
providers.note: Set TWILIO_API_KEY_SID alongside TWILIO_API_KEY_SECRET so VaultProof can build Twilio Basic auth.

providers.label: Shopify
providers.note: Set SHOPIFY_STORE_URL (e.g. https://mystore.myshopify.com) in your .env

providers.label: Jira Cloud
providers.note: Set JIRA_SITE_URL (e.g. https://example.atlassian.net) and JIRA_EMAIL in your .env.

providers.label: Zendesk
providers.note: Set ZENDESK_SITE_URL (e.g. https://example.zendesk.com) and ZENDESK_EMAIL in your .env.

providers.label: Freshdesk
providers.note: Set FRESHDESK_SITE_URL (e.g. https://example.freshdesk.com) in your .env.

providers.label: npm Registry
providers.note: Set npm's registry or your HTTP client's base URL to https://init.vaultproof.dev/p/npm-registry.

providers.label: Qdrant
providers.note: Set QDRANT_URL (e.g. https://example.us-east.aws.cloud.qdrant.io) in your .env.

providers.label: Meilisearch
providers.note: Set MEILISEARCH_URL in your .env.

providers.label: Typesense
providers.note: Set TYPESENSE_URL in your .env.

providers.label: Elasticsearch
providers.note: Set ELASTICSEARCH_URL in your .env. Use the encoded Elasticsearch API key value.

providers.label: Bitbucket Cloud
providers.note: Set BITBUCKET_USERNAME alongside BITBUCKET_APP_PASSWORD so VaultProof can build Bitbucket Basic auth.

providers.label: Okta
providers.note: Set OKTA_ORG_URL (e.g. https://example.okta.com) in your .env.

providers.label: Stytch
providers.note: Set STYTCH_PROJECT_ID alongside STYTCH_SECRET so VaultProof can build Stytch Basic auth.

providers.label: ActiveCampaign
providers.note: Set ACTIVECAMPAIGN_API_URL from your ActiveCampaign account, usually ending in /api/3.

providers.label: Braze
providers.note: Set BRAZE_REST_ENDPOINT for your Braze instance, such as https://rest.iad-01.braze.com.

providers.label: Vonage
providers.note: Set VONAGE_API_KEY alongside VONAGE_API_SECRET so VaultProof can build Vonage Basic auth.

providers.label: Plivo
providers.note: Set PLIVO_AUTH_ID alongside PLIVO_AUTH_TOKEN so VaultProof can build Plivo Basic auth.

providers.label: Directus
providers.note: Set DIRECTUS_URL in your .env.

providers.label: Strapi
providers.note: Set STRAPI_URL in your .env.

providers.label: Hygraph
providers.note: Set HYGRAPH_ENDPOINT to your Hygraph Content or Management API endpoint.

providers.label: Contentstack
providers.note: Set CONTENTSTACK_API_KEY alongside CONTENTSTACK_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN.

providers.label: HashiCorp Vault
providers.note: Set VAULT_ADDR to your public HTTPS Vault address.

providers.label: 1Password Connect
providers.note: Set OP_CONNECT_HOST to your 1Password Connect server URL.

providers.label: Make
providers.note: Set MAKE_API_BASE_URL for your Make zone, such as https://eu1.make.com/api/v2.

providers.label: n8n
providers.note: Set N8N_URL to your n8n instance root URL.

providers.label: InfluxDB
providers.note: Set INFLUX_URL to your InfluxDB Cloud or self-hosted root URL.

providers.label: BrowserStack
providers.note: Set BROWSERSTACK_USERNAME alongside BROWSERSTACK_ACCESS_KEY so VaultProof can build Basic auth.

providers.label: Auth0
providers.note: Set AUTH0_DOMAIN_URL to your tenant root URL, such as https://example.us.auth0.com.

providers.label: FusionAuth
providers.note: Set FUSIONAUTH_URL to your FusionAuth instance root URL.

providers.label: Redis Cloud
providers.note: Set REDIS_CLOUD_ACCOUNT_KEY alongside REDIS_CLOUD_USER_KEY.

providers.label: ClickHouse Cloud
providers.note: Set CLICKHOUSE_API_KEY_ID alongside CLICKHOUSE_API_KEY_SECRET so VaultProof can build Basic auth.

providers.label: Razorpay
providers.note: Set RAZORPAY_KEY_ID alongside RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET so VaultProof can build Basic auth.
